An '''aerial recon trooper''' was a [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|clone jet trooper]] trained with [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|aerial reconnaissance]] skills to monitor [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces from the air and relay the location of specific enemy positions to their squad members on the ground.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=Battle Pack|pack=Anti-Hailfire Droid Squad|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWBPAnti-Hailfire.asp}}</ref>

==History==
Aerial recon troopers were used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in response to key enemy threats to clone platoons. They would monitor approaching [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces from the air and relay target positions to a team on the ground that was assigned to assault specific enemy units.<ref name="Hasbro" /> An aerial recon trooper was assigned to [[Bantha Squad (Clone Wars)|Bantha Squad]] to assist in pinpointing and attacking [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire droids]] in advancing [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] groups.<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Equipment==
In addition to being outfitted in white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I armor]], with light- and dark-green designs to mark their squad affiliation, aerial recon troopers wore [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] on their backs for aerial maneuverability. They also wore [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] on their helmets and carried special communications equipment to relay key tactical information.<ref name="Hasbro" /> Aerial recon troopers used the [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] blaster carbine as a compact alternative to the standard-issue [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]]. Jetpacks featured built-in [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]], which would cause devastating blasts against enemy units, and a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] to carry extra equipment.<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[August]], [[2010]], [[Hasbro]] released the ''Anti-Hailfire Droid Squad Battle Pack'' as part of their ''Shadow of the Dark Side'' toy line to introduce [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|Season 3]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]]. The two Clone Troopers, Aerial Recon Trooper and Clone Commander figures came with weapon accessories and 4 Galactic Battle Game cards with images from an as yet un-aired Clone Wars television series episode, 4 battle bases and 1 game die.<ref name="Hasbro" />
